description:
Find Sentry Metric Monitors that alert when an error count, latency, log, metric, or crash rate crosses a threshold. Returns monitor IDs, queries, and connected Alerts.
Cron jobs: find_monitors. URL checks: find_uptime_monitors. Notifications: alert rules.

cursor.description: Next cursor from the previous page, with the same filters.

organizationSlug.description: The organization slug, from `find_organizations`. In `org/project` notation, the part before the slash.

projectSlug.description: The project slug, or lowercase `all` for every project.

query.description: Monitor search, such as a name or name:"latency". Matches monitor metadata, not the monitored event query.

anyOf.description: The organization's region URL from `find_organizations`, e.g. `https://us.sentry.io`. Omit for self-hosted Sentry.

name: find_metric_monitors
title: Find Metric Monitors
